card.name: Possessive before body part after lie/roll on
card.fires_on: The possessive (its, her, his, their) or the word after it, right after a verb or preposition of body position such as roll on, lie on, land on, placed upon. It predicts a body part or surface like side, back, heels.

modes.label: Possessive after position phrase
modes.description: A possessive pronoun follows a body-position verb plus on or upon, before side, back or heels.
modes.example: the body should be rolled on to<< its>> side and the plastic stuck underneath the body

modes.label: Lie upon the
modes.description: The word upon or the follows lie, before back or abdomen.
modes.example: should lie<< upon>> the back and the abdomen, changing these

card.writes: It pushes the model toward words for direction or orientation, such as backward, and away from unrelated names.
card.plain: It fires on 'his/her/its' after phrases like 'lie on' or 'roll onto', when a body side or back comes next.
